# Psalm 31 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 31:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. A-psalm of-David.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. A psalm of David.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. A psalm of David.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 31:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** In-You, YHWH, I-take-refuge; let-me-never be-put-to-shame; in-Your-righteousness deliver-me.
- **LOGOS:** In You, O LORD, I take refuge; let me never be put to shame; in Your righteousness deliver me!
- **PNEUMA:** LORD, I have come to You for protection; don't let me be disgraced. Save me, for You do what is right.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 31:8 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** I-will-be-glad and-rejoice in-Your-steadfast-love, because You-have-seen my-affliction; You-have-known the-distresses of-my-soul.
- **LOGOS:** I will rejoice and be glad in Your steadfast love, because You have seen my affliction; You have known the distress of my soul,
- **PNEUMA:** I will be glad and rejoice in Your unfailing love, for You have seen my troubles, and You care about the anguish of my soul.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 31:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-You-have-not given-me-over into-the-hand of-the-enemy; You-have-set my-feet in-a-broad-place.
- **LOGOS:** and You have not delivered me into the hand of the enemy; You have set my feet in a broad place.
- **PNEUMA:** You have not handed me over to my enemies but have set me in a safe place.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 31:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For my-life is-spent with-sorrow, and-my-years with-groaning; my-strength fails because-of my-iniquity, and-my-bones waste-away.
- **LOGOS:** For my life is spent with sorrow, and my years with sighing; my strength fails because of my iniquity, and my bones waste away.
- **PNEUMA:** I am dying from grief; my years are shortened by sadness. Sin has drained my strength; I am wasting away from within.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 31:13 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** I-am-forgotten like-a-dead-man, out-of-mind; I-am like-a-vessel that-is-destroyed.
- **LOGOS:** I have been forgotten like one who is dead; I have become like a broken vessel.
- **PNEUMA:** I am forgotten — as good as dead. I am like a broken pot, discarded and thrown away.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
